Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
I wonder how the three following cards operate in combination:

Pulled Fangs
XTC-Laced Blood
Reality (at inferior)

Reality and XTC-Laced Blood will put the targeted vampire in an
action-limbo (must hunt and can only act to remove Reality), but
does the vampire still qualify for the 'must hunt' that will
trigger torporizing from Pulled Fangs? I guess yes, but would
like confirmation.

And, yes, I'm aware that Pulled Fangs and XTC-Laced Blood together
will torporize the target, but sometimes you want to make sure
that noone resques the vamp cross-table.

Sten During

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sten During wrote:
>
> I wonder how the three following cards operate in combination:
>
> Pulled Fangs
> XTC-Laced Blood
> Reality (at inferior)
>
> Reality and XTC-Laced Blood will put the targeted vampire in an
> action-limbo (must hunt and can only act to remove Reality), but
> does the vampire still qualify for the 'must hunt' that will
> trigger torporizing from Pulled Fangs? I guess yes, but would
> like confirmation.

Yes.
PF: cannot hunt.
Reality: cannot hunt.
XTC: must hunt.
PF: "must hunt" means "goes to torpor".

So the Reality is superfluous in that set-up (except as you note below).

> And, yes, I'm aware that Pulled Fangs and XTC-Laced Blood together
> will torporize the target, but sometimes you want to make sure
> that noone resques the vamp cross-table.

Someone could still burn the XTC cross-table, of course.
